findings.issue: Partial or historical native timing could overstate checkpoint evidence completeness or openness.
findings.disposition: Fixed: distinguish source-open proof from historical timing and propagate partial evidence without changing numeric facts.

findings.issue: Synthetic Codex accounting IDs could be presented as native checkpoint interval IDs.
findings.disposition: Fixed: retain actual native-ID presence and qualify synthetic accounting fallback only.

findings.issue: Stale v2 running-tool state could override native idle in source-open feedback.
findings.disposition: Fixed: optional native idle metadata qualifies feedback only; errors remain nonfatal and numeric accounting unchanged.

findings.issue: OpenCode tests did not protect feedback qualification against future superseding messages.
findings.disposition: Fixed: both-family durable assertions detect removal of future-message supersession guards.

findings.issue: The read-only stderr fixture was suspected of remaining writable under root.
findings.disposition: Refuted: an O_RDONLY descriptor remains unwritable under root; added failed-write fixture preflight. No production defect.
